miert_adunk.title: Why do we give free drinks?
miert_adunk.content:
Because we believe everyone deserves a little joy — and we partner with top drink brands so you can try new drinks first. Brands want to meet you, and bars love welcoming new faces.

Your presence and feedback are gold: you help make your favorite drinks even better, discover new flavors, and explore places you might not visit otherwise.

hogyan_juthatsz.title: How to claim a free drink?
hogyan_juthatsz.content:
Check the partner venues and active offers in the app. Offers depend on stock, opening hours and the configured time window.

At the venue, select the offer. The app shows a short-lived QR code; staff scan and approve it in the partner portal. The app then confirms a successful redemption.

Never send or publicly share the full QR code or redemption secret.

miert_nem_latok.title: Why don’t I see offers right now?
miert_nem_latok.content: There may be no active, in-stock offer in your area or current time window. Check again later; payment-card linking and automatic purchase rewards are not part of the current beta.

miert_zarolva.title: Why is the free drink locked for me?
miert_zarolva.content: You must be signed in, allow foreground location and be near the venue during the active offer window. Sold-out, expired or paused offers cannot be redeemed. Payment-card linking is not part of the current beta.

van_limit.title: Is there a limit?
van_limit.content: Normal accounts can complete at most one successful free-drink redemption per Budapest calendar day, and an offer may also have its own stock and time-window limits. Availability is never guaranteed.

adhatok_visszajelzest.title: Can I give more feedback?
adhatok_visszajelzest.content: Yes! We may send a short survey after a drink. We care about your honest experience — that’s how we keep improving.

maradt_kerdes.title: Still have questions?
maradt_kerdes.content: Message us on live chat — we’re happy to help. 👊

mi_az_a_rewards.title: What is Come Get It Rewards?
mi_az_a_rewards.content: The Rewards tab shows points actually credited in the app and currently active rewards. Availability, required point values and stock may vary by partner. The current beta does not connect to your payment card or monitor purchases.

hogyan_szerezhetek_pontokat.title: How do I earn points?
hogyan_szerezhetek_pontokat.content: Only points actually credited in the app can be used during the beta. There is no automatic card-linked earning and no active referral bonus. If your balance looks wrong, email gataibence@gmail.com.

mire_kolthetem.title: What can I spend points on?
mire_kolthetem.content: Rewards are carefully curated — from lifestyle and fashion to top brand perks. See the current catalog in the Rewards tab. We update it frequently — and we’d love your suggestions!

hogyan_osszekotom.title: How do I link my card?
hogyan_osszekotom.content: Payment-card linking is not available in the current free beta, so the app does not ask for or store card details.

biztonsag.title: Is my data secure?
biztonsag.content: Authentication and app data are protected with access controls and encrypted transport. The current beta does not collect payment-card data. Never send your password, complete QR code or redemption secret by email or chat.

kartya_frissitese.title: How can I update my card details?
kartya_frissitese.content: There is nothing to update: the current beta does not connect to a payment card or store card details.

minden_tranzakcio.title: Do you see all my transactions?
minden_tranzakcio.content: No. The current beta is not linked to your payment card and cannot access card transactions. It only handles Come Get It redemption and reward data.

lejarnak_pontok.title: Do my points expire?
lejarnak_pontok.content: The point balance and reward conditions currently shown in the beta apply. We will announce material changes in advance; points cannot be exchanged for cash.

online_fizetes.title: Do you support online/table payments?
online_fizetes.content: No. The current Come Get It beta does not process payments or offer in-app purchases. You pay the venue directly for any on-site purchase.

miert_nem_kaptam_pontot.title: Why didn’t I receive points for a transaction?
miert_nem_kaptam_pontot.content: The current beta does not automatically award points for payment-card transactions. If an already credited balance or reward appears incorrectly, email gataibence@gmail.com and never send full QR codes or card details.
